notes.title: "Out of Order" achievement fixed! Sorry about that!
notes.content: [p]Thanks to your reports, we've found and fixed the "Out of Order" achievement failing to trigger. Simple mistake, easy to update. 3.1.4 is live now! Let us know if you spot any other issues.[/p][p] - Kane[/p]

notes.title: Fighting Chance: WRAPPED UP! is NOW OUT!
notes.content: [h1]BE AWARE THAT SPOILER TAGS ARE BROKEN AT THE MOMENT![/h1][p]It's here! We have been updating POPGOES Arcade: Fighting Chance behind the scenes, using your feedback to improve the game in some big and small ways. The WRAPPED UP! update should now be live on Steam, and you can check out all of the changes here.[/p][p][b]If you are new to the game, I would recommend you play the game WITHOUT reading the changelog. Just hop in right now! If you're a veteran player and you want to know what's new or what to look out for, feel free to read through - I have spoiler tagged the bigger stuff.[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]POPGOES Arcade: Fighting Chance - WRAPPED UP! (3.1.3)[/h1][h3][b]NEW: Achievement Warnings[/b][/h3][p]Players have expressed some frustration regarding missable achievements exclusively available in The Dead Forest. Unfortunately we are not able to temporarily bring the player back to their campaign in The Dead Forest to collect these kinds of achievements, so we have implemented a compromise for new players.[/p][list][*][p]Achievements that are unlocked exclusively in The Dead Forest (and can be missed) now have a green asterisk in the in-game achievement menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Hovering over achievements with this asterisk will display a warning, "Unavailable after The Dead Forest".[/p][/*][*][p]9 achievements in the game have this tag.[/p][list][*][p]It Gets Easier - Lose against a Corrupt Hedgehog before upgrading any stats.[/p][/*][*][p]Pop Champ - Defeat 100 enemies in POPGOES: The Dead Forest.[/p][/*][*][p]You Should Be Golden - Encounter a \[spoiler]Gilded enemy\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][*][p]Fool's Gold - Escape from a \[spoiler]Gilded enemy\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][*][p]B Polite, B Efficient - Complete all of BB's hit lists without spending money on any of them.[/p][/*][*][p]I'm Sorry I Axed - \[spoiler]Find something in the well\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][*][p]In Its Code - \[spoiler]Witness the Blackrabbit\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][*][p]Out of Order! - \[spoiler]Betray the soul at the last moment\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][*][p]Paranormal Reactivity - \[spoiler]Bring the soul back to the arcade cabinet\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW: [/b]\[spoiler][b]Gilded Hat[/b]\[/spoiler][b]'s New Purpose[/b][/h3][p]The Money Boots perk from older versions of POPGOES Arcade was replaced by the new "Quick Pocket" ability in Fighting Chance. Money Boots would provide passive money generation, granting small amounts of coins based on how long Popgoes has been walking (even in totally safe areas, like The Garden). We found that Money Boots was overkill in Fighting Chance, and allowed for some unintended "playstyles", hence its removal.[/p][p]However, we have decided to add the perk back but as a reward that is tied to the \[spoiler]Gilded Hat\[/spoiler], which is granted to the player once they reach 200% completion in The Machinist. This sounds redundant on paper, because the game is effectively over by this point, but the \[spoiler]Gilded Hat\[/spoiler] is one of three items in the game that are retained in a New Game. This means you can play the game again, maybe to collect leftover achievements, and have an easier time purchasing items and unlocks. [/p][list][*][p]Wearing the \[spoiler]Gilded Hat\[/spoiler] will generate 5 coins for every 15 seconds of walking (20 coins per minute), before unlocking the Speed Boost from BB.[/p][/*][*][p]Upon unlocking the Speed Boost, coin generation is increased to 5 coins every 7.5 seconds of walking (40 coins per minute).[/p][/*][*][p]When the player first beats the game at 200%, a new information box will pop up that explains the properties of the \[spoiler]Gilded Hat\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW: [/b]\[spoiler][b]Achievement Statue[/b]\[/spoiler][/h3][p]Some players expressed disappointment in zero in-game acknowledgement of all achievements being unlocked (especially since myPOPGOES does have a special reward for this). So now, upon completing all 50 achievements, \[spoiler]a statue will appear in The Garden\[/spoiler].[/p][list][*][p]\[spoiler]The statue appears in the cell below the inn, instead of inside your bedroom.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]It can be interacted with, to read \[spoiler]the plaque attached to it\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements do not get reset on New Game (though they do if you use the file wiping option in the ESC menu), so \[spoiler]the statue will also remain\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][/list][h3]\[spoiler][b]The Puppet's Challenge[/b]\[/spoiler][b] Balancing[/b][/h3][p]\[spoiler]The battle with The Puppet, which becomes available after completing the wishlist, is being rebalanced following player feedback.\[/spoiler][/p][list][*][p]\[spoiler]The Puppet should no longer be able to spawn two of the same Gifts in a row.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]The SHOWDOWN phase of the battle is being adjusted.\[/spoiler][/p][list][*][p]\[spoiler]The initial, non-"spinning" segment of SHOWDOWN will now be 2 phases of 1 move, instead of 2 phases of 3.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]"Incorrect" moves throughout SHOWDOWN will no longer deal damage to the player, and will instead increment the music box.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]SHOWDOWN's Gift description will change during the "spinning" segment, to let the player know that this is when they can act.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]The Puppet will no longer heal himself from death with TEDIUM, and will instead just move to the next Gift.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]The Puppet's instant shield now says "SHIELD!" instead of "BLOCK!", to better illustrate that it can be broken with SCYTHE or Shield Piercers.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bestiary/Index Battle Simulation Changes[/b][/h3][p]We have taken a look at the "battle simulation" option offered by the Bestiary and Index and will be changing some parts of it.[/p][list][*][p]You can now exit battle simulations with a new "Abort" button, where Escape would usually be.[/p][list][*][p]This is invisible via \[spoiler]The Puppet (because Gifts are active and must be readable)\[/spoiler] but it can still be used with E.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Rematching \[spoiler]Dead King Freddy\[/spoiler] in The Machinist will revert certain player stats and abilities.[/p][list][*][p]Health and attack will be lowered to 300 and 30, if you have exceeded those amounts.[/p][/*][*][p]If you have unlocked \[spoiler]SCYTHE, it will be changed to HOOK\[/spoiler] (purely cosmetic in this battle).[/p][/*][*][p]Shield Piercer and Ability Recharge will both be unavailable.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]In previous builds, successfully hitting \[spoiler]DKF during his gold phase would not display Golden Freddy if the attack was a random crit.\[/spoiler] This is fixed.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h3][p]A few parts of the game have been rebalanced based on player feedback.[/p][list][*][p]EXCAVATION has been reworked. It can now give between 0 and 3 scrap, instead of an equal coin flip between 0 or 1. Higher scrap yields are rarer.[/p][list][*][p]40% chance of 0 scrap.[/p][/*][*][p]30% chance of 1 scrap.[/p][/*][*][p]20% chance of 2 scrap.[/p][/*][*][p]10% chance of 3 scrap.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Charged Robot enemies can no longer activate shields immediately after one has expired. There will now always be at least one turn between them.[/p][/*][*][p]The rarity of \[spoiler]the special gift\[/spoiler] has been adjusted.[/p][list][*][p]By default, it will be rarer. It is being changed from a base 1/100 chance, to a base 1/300 chance.[/p][/*][*][p]However, moving to The Machinist will double the chance from 1/300 to 1/150.[/p][/*][*][p]The chance can be doubled again by completing the wishlist, changing it from 1/150 to 1/75.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Popgoes will now jump every time JUMP is used.[/p][list][*][p]Previously, he would not jump if the enemy used their turn to charge or activate a shield.[/p][/*][*][p]This was not a bug. But, by changing this, we have effectively buffed SHOCKWAVE.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Various QOL Changes[/b][/h3][p]Other parts of the game have been changed, mostly just visually, to improve the overall experience.[/p][list][*][p]A new intro frame exists when the game has detected that it's being played on a Steam Deck, encouraging the installation of Proton GE.[/p][list][*][p](Video playback simply does not work on Steam Deck without Proton GE installed.)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]If you have Quick Pocket active (at the start of a battle), the Items button will have a special icon to remind you that it can be used.[/p][/*][*][p]Tunnel's minimap will now show hints for \[spoiler]the secret overworld gifts that appear when the ribbon is equipped\[/spoiler], based on what colour you are wearing.[/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]The plushie on the bed will now emit gilded particles, if you are wearing the gilded hat.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]You can now get Gifts in battles with \[spoiler]Gilded enemies\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][*][p]The "You Win" screen is now silent upon defeating \[spoiler]The Mangle\[/spoiler] to preserve the intense moment.[/p][/*][*][p]The Help/Tips menu now describes the ESC option as "Settings / Exit Game" instead of just "Exit".[/p][/*][*][p]You can now hold left/right to quickly scroll through achievements in the in-game achievement menu.[/p][/*][*][p]The description for SHOCKWAVE now outright mentions that the damage it deals can bypass enemy shields.[/p][/*][*][p]The description for PERSISTENCE now makes it clear that its effect can be used indefinitely.[/p][/*][*][p]Deleting save data via the ESC menu now has some visual feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]At the end of The Dead Forest, Sara will now immediately give Popgoes the final emerald coin instead of asking him to talk to her later for it.[/p][/*][*][p]Certain achievements like In Its Code, Out of Order and Paranormal Activity will now wait until the title screen before being activated.[/p][/*][*][p]Some parts of The Puppet's overworld presence have been improved, mostly to avoid confusion regarding some mechanics.[/p][list][*][p]The box on The Puppet's desk (which toggles Battle Gifts being active) will now flash upon its initial spawning, to encourage the player to open it.[/p][/*][*][p]The Puppet's \[spoiler]death note now directly states that the ribbon will persist across a new game\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug/Issue Fixes[/b][/h3][p]The significant changes introduced with Fighting Chance led to some (mostly minor) bugs and oversights being discovered by players. Thankfully, we have now fixed everything that we were able to investigate and replicate.[/p][list][*][p]Having a controller connected to the game led to some bugs and oversights which we have now addressed.[/p][list][*][p]The ESC menu now has prompts for players using a controller. Deleting save data is now possible.[/p][/*][*][p]Using keyboard override with a controller plugged in would make the \[spoiler]interactive portion of the 200% cutscene\[/spoiler] buggy. This is fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]The in-game achievement menu should now immediately display the correct prompt for exiting it with a controller.[/p][/*][*][p]The Help/Tips menu no longer says "ESC" when a controller is connected. It will display the relevant glyph.[/p][/*][*][p]One of the bulletin board messages would overflow with a controller connected. We've fixed this by adding a glyph to the game's alphabet.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]A few bugs tied to The Puppet's overworld presence were found and fixed.[/p][list][*][p]The Puppet's greeting note at Corrupt Chica's area will now spawn immediately. Some players missed it on FC's launch due to a bug.[/p][/*][*][p]The Puppet's \[spoiler]death note\[/spoiler] should now be animated correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]You should now be able to purchase The Puppet's jukebox track \[spoiler]even before you defeat him (as long as you've activated the battle once)\[/spoiler]. [/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]The Puppet's ribbon\[/spoiler] will now fall into place instead of snapping into existence.[/p][/*][*][p]The box on the table will no longer spawn particles during The Dead Forest's \[spoiler]"night mode"\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Some achievements were not behaving correctly.[/p][list][*][p]Coupon and On should now activate immediately upon redeeming 30 stamps, instead of waiting for the game's frame to update.[/p][/*][*][p]The Pop Champ achievement had an incorrect/incomplete description. The 100 enemies must be defeated during the first chapter of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]A new check has been added to the game's title screen to help with re-activating missing achievements.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Digging up a Fruit will no longer display the healing number of an Acorn (the actual healed amount was always correct thankfully).[/p][/*][*][p]Using Dig while in an underground battle will no longer briefly dislodge the battle's escape chance percentage.[/p][/*][*][p]The Dead Forest's bulletin board has unique functionality at 99% completion which was bugged on launch. This is fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Increase Chance" button in the Wishlist will no longer be permanently highlighted when Gifts are at 100% chance.[/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]Prototype Manora, and the Laser Pillar,\[/spoiler] will now only be added to the Index if the player has actually seen them in the \[spoiler]Morse\[/spoiler] battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Blank/empty save files will no longer be falsely detected as corrupt by the game. [/p][/*][*][p]Holly's description for HP UP would falsely call it "expensive", even though it now starts at a very low price. This has changed.[/p][/*][*][p]Popgoes now reads the locks on the north forest gate in the correct order.[/p][/*][*][p]Breaking a shield with the \[spoiler]SCYTHE ability\[/spoiler] will now play the Shield Piercer sound effect.[/p][/*][*][p]The description for the \[spoiler]secret gift\[/spoiler] has had a minor sprite error fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a quadruple-period typo in one of The Puppet's lines.[/p][/*][*][p]Exiting to the title screen from a silent room (like The Puppet's) will no longer bug out the game's audio upon selecting Continue.[/p][/*][*][p]A visual bug on the scrubber at the bottom of the Jukebox UI has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]You should no longer be able to walk away from the \[spoiler]Machinist's hideout area\[/spoiler] after dialogue has been triggered.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a very subtle animation error regarding the west forest's falling leaf particles.[/p][/*][*][p]BALANCE will now stop making calculations that involve health numbers below 0 (such as with an overkilled enemy).[/p][/*][*][p]The uncharged JUMP button will now play a "failed" sound effect when attempted, like the other two battle abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some bugs regarding damage numbers in battles.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you to everyone who played through Fighting Chance and gave their feedback! Please enjoy this latest version and let us know if you spot anything that may have slipped through the cracks. We want this game totally sorted before it's sent off for porting! Let's go![/p][p] - Kane[/p]

notes.title: POPGOES Arcade: Fighting Chance is NOW OUT!
notes.content: [previewyoutube="w-0aAZdwxCQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]A major update for POPGOES Arcade, [b]"Fighting Chance"[/b], is now available to download. It's a free, mandatory patch to the game that improves the gameplay experience in a multitude of exciting ways.[/p][p]This update was announced exactly 1 year ago and is now finally finished, on the 9th anniversary of POPGOES (2016). Well, all of the planned content has been implemented and works as intended, but you may still run into some very minor bugs, especially on Steam's side (things like achievements). So please keep us updated on how things go![/p][p]We are insanely proud of this new version of POPGOES Arcade. I have surveyed our playtesters, made up of new and old players, and ratings for the game are now consistently a 9 or 10 out of 10. If you're new to the series, this is the perfect time to jump in. And if you've already completed POPGOES Arcade before, here is your excuse to revisit the game to see how much nicer it is. [/p][p][b]If you are new to the game, I would recommend you play the game WITHOUT reading the changelog. Just hop in right now! If you're a veteran player and you want to know what's new or what to look out for, feel free to read through - I have spoiler tagged the bigger stuff.[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]POPGOES Arcade: Fighting Chance (3.0.5)[/h1][h3][b]NEW: Battle Gifts[/b][/h3][p]A new major game mechanic, "Battle Gifts", has been implemented.[/p][list][*][p]Accessible after beating Corrupt Chica and interacting with The Puppet who can be found in Room 1 of any inn.[/p][/*][*][p]Gifts initially spawn in 50% of all normal battles (no bosses, Gilded, or robot mimics), but this can be increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Gifts can be opened on the player's first turn, but will disappear if the player uses any other move/ability.[/p][/*][*][p]Opening a Gift will destroy the Escape button for that battle.[/p][/*][*][p]There are 15 Gifts in total, 9 available from the start of the game, and 6 added exclusively in The Machinist.[/p][/*][*][p]Each Gift applies a special modifier for the battle, applying a positive, neutral, or negative status effect or mechanic.[/p][/*][*][p]Winning a battle with a neutral effect will grant 10 extra coins. Winning one with a negative effect will grant 20. Positive gifts have no monetary reward.[/p][/*][/list][p]Gifts available from The Dead Forest:[/p][list][*][p]\[spoiler]POTENTIAL! - Blocking an attack increases your attack power by 25%. Blocking a charged attack increases it by 75%. Your attack power is reset after any other move is used.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]ABSORPTION! - 25% of the damage that you deal is returned to you as health.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]PERSISTENCE! - When hit with a fatal move, you will automatically consume an Acorn from your inventory, if you have one. This could save your life.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]SLINGSHOT. - Acorns, Fruit and Pizzas now deal instant damage to your enemy (without taking up any turns) instead of providing you with any healing.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]VENGEANCE. - You will deal only half of your attack power while over 75% health, but double your attack power when below 25% health.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]BALANCE. - After every third turn, the health percentages of you and your enemy are equalised. This could save your life.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]TEDIUM... - The enemy in this battle will heal themselves for 5% of their max health after each turn.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]SICKNESS... - Your health will drain slowly over time during this battle.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]\[spoiler]REFLEX... - All of your moves (not items) must be performed at the right moment, or they will fail.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][/list][p]Gifts added in The Machinist, specifically involving the player's "Battle Abilities" (JUMP, HOOK, and/or DIG):[/p][list][*][p]\[spoiler]DETECTION!* - You now know exactly what DIG will provide, before it is used.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]SHOCKWAVE!* - You will deal 100% of your current attack power to your enemy after using JUMP.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]CHANCE.* - JUMP, HOOK, and DIG now have a 33% chance of fully recharging every turn, instead of being on a fixed 3-turn cooldown.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]EXCAVATION.* - Using DIG will now have a 50% chance of unearthing scrap metal instead of granting any consumable items.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]EXHAUSTION...* - Using JUMP, HOOK, or DIG will activate the cooldowns for the other two Battle Abilities as well.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]CLUMSINESS...* - You will lose between 1 and 3 Scrap metal every time you use JUMP.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW: The Wishlist[/b][/h3][p]A new interactive item called the Wishlist, found in Room 1 alongside The Puppet, has been added.[/p][list][*][p]A simple one-page interactive item, similar to the Bestiary and Index. [/p][/*][*][p]Functions as a checklist for all 15 Gifts in the game, immediately revealing all of their names, but not their effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Encountering a Gift in the game will add its description to the Wishlist, as well as a tick next to it to show that it has been "collected" at least once.[/p][/*][*][p]The Wishlist also lets the player increase the chances of battles having Gifts. By spending 50 coins, the chance can be increased by 5%.[/p][list][*][p]Battle Gift chances can be increased from 50% all the way to 100%.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Puppet wants to speak to you once all 15 Gifts have been found.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW: Stamp Loyalty System[/b][/h3][p]Players will now automatically receive a new secondary currency in Holly's Shop, called "Stamps".[/p][list][*][p]This system is designed to encourage the use of consumable items in battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Purchasing any item, including permanent upgrades, will give the player 1/3 of a Stamp. The player can hold a maximum of 3 full Stamps.[/p][/*][*][p]The player can choose to redeem stamps on any consumable item found in the shop.[/p][list][*][p]Low-tier items (Acorns and ATK+) cost 1 Stamp.[/p][/*][*][p]Mid-tier items (Fruits and DEF+) cost 2 Stamps.[/p][/*][*][p]High-tier items (Pizzas and Shields) cost 3 Stamps.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW: Escape Rework[/b][/h3][p]The Escape ability is now available from the start of the game, with some restrictions.[/p][list][*][p]The button now functions as a dice roll. It takes one turn to use, and its chance of succeeding depends on the rarity of the enemy.[/p][list][*][p]Escaping from Common enemies (Deer, Boar, Owl) has a 50% success rate.[/p][/*][*][p]Escaping from Uncommon enemies (Hawk, Cat, Beaver) has a 33% success rate.[/p][/*][*][p]Escaping from Rare enemies (Hedgehog, Woodpecker, Wolf) has a 17% success rate.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]These chances are identical to the spawn likelihoods of the respective enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]You will be able to see the chance of escaping displayed on the Escape button itself.[/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]Upgrading the HOOK ability in the latter half of The Dead Forest will do the same thing, upgrading the escaping chance to 100% for all enemies.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW: \[spoiler]Quick Pocket (Money Boots Replacement)\[/spoiler][/b][/h3][p]The "Money Boots" upgrade from \[spoiler]BB's Black Market\[/spoiler] has been replaced with a new mechanic called "Quick Pocket".[/p][list][*][p]Money Boots would provide passive money generation, which was considered overkill alongside other improvements in Fighting Chance.[/p][/*][*][p]Quick Pocket is a perk that instead lets players \[spoiler]activate a buff item (ATK+, DEF+, or Shield) as their first move in a battle, without ending their turn\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][*][p]For example, the player can \[spoiler]use an ATK+, and then HOOK, both in their first turn of the battle\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][*][p]This gives even more value to consumable items and adds some more strategy to setting up battles, especially bosses.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW: \[spoiler]Tunnel (Shortcut Replacement)\[/spoiler][/b][/h3][p]The "Shortcut" upgrade for the \[spoiler]DIG ability\[/spoiler] has been repurposed into a more convenient mechanic which is now called \[spoiler]"Tunnel"\[/spoiler].[/p][list][*][p]Shortcut would previously allow the player to interact with small dirt holes in the overworld to move from one forest to another.[/p][/*][*][p]Tunnel now \[spoiler]allows the player to instantly travel from anywhere in the overworld, to any Inn or Shop, by holding space (or the bottom face button, on controller)\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]A minimap of the world is displayed, showing each possible destination, when in the menu for Tunnel\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][*][p]This ability is not available if the player is inside of a building, or is in one of the underground areas.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW: Bulletin Boards[/b][/h3][p]A new sign in the garden, in the same cell that Popgoes begins his journey in, has been added. It has a unique, large sprite, resembling a village bulletin board with green accents and a vague "TDF" written at the top. [/p][list][*][p]This object exists to give gameplay tips that are relevant through the Dead Forest campaign.[/p][/*][*][p]It presents information that most veteran players will already know, but is not actually explained in the game elsewhere.[/p][/*][*][p]10 tips in total are displayed, cycling in order. The cycle is reset if the player enters a new frame, like triggering a battle.[/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]This board will be "haunted", either when the player is at exactly 99% completion, or if they are currently in the "night mode" portion of the game.\[/spoiler][/p][list][*][p]\[spoiler]The haunted variant of the board will have a unique sprite, and give a glitched, vague hint about the route to freeing Bonnie's soul.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]A second bulletin board, with orange accents and a vague "ATM" written at the top, is added when the player begins the second chapter of the game.[/p][list][*][p]This board will give 10 completely new tips, specifically about the Machinist campaign.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Dialogue and Battle Efficiency Changes[/b][/h3][p]A new feature has been added to dialogue in the game.[/p][list][*][p]Holding space (bottom face button) when reading dialogue will continue to work as usual: it will speed through text and stop when the current line is concluded.[/p][/*][*][p]The E button (right face button) now has a function when reading dialogue. Hold it, and it will speed through text and immediately move to the next line if there is one.[/p][/*][/list][p]Animations in battles have been reduced, and the experience is now more efficient in general.[/p][list][*][p]The pause between turns for the player and enemy has been reduced slightly. Battles are about 20% faster than the initial Steam release.[/p][/*][*][p]The player can now hold the space button (bottom face button) to continuously repeat the currently selected move/ability. [/p][list][*][p]This also works with the E button (right face button), to continuously attempt an Escape from the battle (regardless of what the player has selected).[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]The Machinist Balance Changes[/b][/h3][p]Some changes in Fighting Chance made progressing through The Machinist too fast/easy in our testing. We have mitigated this with other adjustments.[/p][list][*][p]Permanent upgrades from Blake's Smithing have been adjusted to slow down progression and allow more specific Overkill requirements.[/p][list][*][p]+10 HP or +2 ATK for 4 Scrap is now +5 HP or +1 ATK for 3 Scrap.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Escaping from \[spoiler]Charged Robots\[/spoiler] (underground) will be a dice roll, even though the player will have the guaranteed Escape at this point.[/p][list][*][p]The chance of escaping will directly correlate to the player's current maximum health stat. 300 HP is a 30% chance. 500 HP is a 50% chance.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The \[spoiler]Tunnel ability\[/spoiler] is disabled in underground areas. The player must make their way out of the caves before they are able to use it.[/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]Charged Robots\[/spoiler] are now able to use their \[spoiler]Shield ability\[/spoiler] multiple times per battle.[/p][list][*][p]\[spoiler]Shield Piercer\[/spoiler] has been adjusted as a result. It will now only be consumed (after activation) if it \[spoiler]successfully destroys a shield\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]Prototype Manora's\[/spoiler] shield generation chance has been reduced from 50% to 30% due to this change as well.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]Scrapbots\[/spoiler] have been buffed. Their health stats have been increased by +50%, and their miss chances have been lowered from 20% to 10%.[/p][/*][*][p]One more \[spoiler]Scrapbot\[/spoiler] has been added to each forest. There are now 3 per forest, 9 in total.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]In-Game Achievements[/b][/h3][p]For the sake of parity across platforms like mobile and Nintendo Switch, achievements have been added to the game itself, via custom notifications and a menu.[/p][list][*][p]Achievements now appear in-game via notifications anchored to the top-right of the arcade cabinet's monitor.[/p][list][*][p]Notifications are titled, and colour-coded based on which chapter they originate from. Some have other, special designs.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]In-game achievements are stored in a new, unencrypted save file, next to the encrypted campaign progression save file.[/p][list][*][p]It is possible to manually edit the file to unlock achievements, but this will not trigger them on Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]The game can not read data from Steam, so you will need to re-collect them for the in-game achievement collection (or cheat them in).[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]New Achievements[/b][/h3][p]Fighting Chance adds 5 new achievements for each chapter of the game.[/p][p]POPGOES: The Dead Forest:[/p][list][*][p]\[spoiler][b]Fool's Gold[/b] - Escape from a Gilded enemy.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p][b]Coupon and On[/b] - Redeem 30 Stamps at Holly's shop.[/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler][b]Out of Order![/b] - Betray the soul at the last moment.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p][b]Spoiled[/b] - Open 100 Battle Gifts.[/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler][b]Happiest Day[/b] - Open a gift from someone else.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][/list][p]POPGOES and The Machinist:[/p][list][*][p]\[spoiler][b]Contactless[/b] - Defeat a robot with no physical contact. Not even shields.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler][b]Commitment Issues[/b] - Leave her hanging.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p][b]One of Everything[/b] - Open one of each Battle Gift.[/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler][b]\[REDACTED][/b] - Complete the challenge.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler][b]\[REDACTED][/b] - Complete the challenge without using the Hook battle ability.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][/list][p]On top of this, one of the existing achievements has been tweaked to be more forgiving:[/p][list][*][p]\[spoiler][b]Dethroned Ultra[/b] - Defeat the King of the Castle without using any battle abilities.\[/spoiler][/p][list][*][p](This achievement previously demanded that the player not even unlock any of the battle abilities.)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Economy Balancing[/b][/h3][p]To make battle rewards more balanced throughout the game (mitigating farming in specific areas), and to speed up the (less exciting) first portion of the game, the economy of POPGOES Arcade has been adjusted in a few ways.[/p][list][*][p]Coin rewards for defeating enemies in The Dead Forest have been adjusted.[/p][list][*][p]East Forest and North Forest enemies give 5 more coins each.[/p][/*][*][p]West Forest enemies give 5 fewer coins each.[/p][/*][*][p]South Forest enemies are unchanged.[/p][/*][*][p]On top of this, \[spoiler]+ (Plus) enemies\[/spoiler] in the second half of the game (in all forests) will give 5 more coins each.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The prices of HP UP and ATK UP in Holly's shop are now dynamic, with a "Supply and Demand" mechanic (which is explained in-game).[/p][list][*][p]Prices will start very low (15 coins for the first HP UP, 30 coins for the first ATK UP).[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Prices will increase as they are purchased. HP UP and ATK UP will increase by 5 coins every time they are purchased.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The total cost to fully upgrade Popgoes is increased, but progression is faster in the first half of The Dead Forest and slower in the second half.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Cost of consumables and other purchasables have been adjusted.[/p][list][*][p]Price of Acorns has been increased to 20 coins (from 10).[/p][/*][*][p]Price of Fruits has been increased to 40 coins (from 25).[/p][/*][*][p]Price of Pizzas has been increased to 60 coins (from 40).[/p][/*][*][p]Price of ATK+ has been increased to 25 coins (from 15).[/p][/*][*][p]Price of DEF+ has been increased to 50 coins (from 30).[/p][/*][*][p]Price of Shield has been increased to 75 coins (from 45).[/p][/*][*][p]Price of songs in the Jukebox has been decreased to 25 coins (from 40).[/p][/*][*][p]Price of \[spoiler]Super Speed (BB's Black Market)\[/spoiler] has been increased to 200 coins (from 150).[/p][/*][*][p]Price of \[spoiler]Quick Pocket (BB's Black Market)\[/spoiler] has been increased to 250 coins (from 200, originally as Money Boots).[/p][/*][*][p]Price of \[spoiler]Spiky Shield (BB's Black Market)\[/spoiler] has been increased to 300 coins (from 250).[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Enemy Spawn Changes[/b][/h3][p]Enemy spawn chances, and the areas in the game which increase spawn chances, are being adjusted.[/p][list][*][p]Enemies will spawn less frequently when the player walks on dirt paths in the forests and when walking on rail tracks underground.[/p][/*][*][p]Adversely, enemies spawn more frequently (even more than previously) when the player walks "off-road" throughout the game.[/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]Corruption Hotspots (red clouds in The Dead Forest)\[/spoiler] and \[spoiler]Power Surges (blue clouds in The Machinist)\[/spoiler] now halve the player's movement speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Battles triggered via \[spoiler]Corruption Hotspots and Power Surges\[/spoiler] now feature new particle effects in their backgrounds.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Title Screen Medal Changes[/b][/h3][p]The medals that appear in the title screen for the game have been expanded and updated in a few ways.[/p][list][*][p]The medal sprite for Corrupt Bonnie has been updated to now have a nose.[/p][/*][*][p]The medal sprites for \[spoiler]Rusty Chica and Pristine Bonnie now resemble their actual designs ("Withered" features, and accurate colour schemes).\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]The medals for \[spoiler]Super Speed and Spiky Shield\[/spoiler] have been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Two new medals have been added.[/p][list][*][p]A medal for defeating \[spoiler]The Mangle\[/spoiler] will appear in the top position of a new row.[/p][/*][*][p]A second medal, for completing a new part of Fighting Chance, will appear below \[spoiler]The Mangle's\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Jukebox Update[/b][/h3][p]The Jukebox, which is unlocked after completing all three of \[spoiler]BB's "hitlists"\[/spoiler], has been updated.[/p][list][*][p]The player can now purchase and listen to the \[spoiler]"Secret Boss" track (The Mangle's theme)\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][*][p]The player can now purchase and listen to a brand new track.[/p][/*][*][p]The buttons for the Jukebox's UI have been redesigned to be much more consistently shaped/sized.[/p][/*][*][p]The play and pause icons have been swapped, so that they resemble buttons being pressed instead of representing the current status of the song.[/p][/*][*][p]As mentioned earlier, the price of all songs in the Jukebox has been decreased to 25 coins (from 40).[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Various Minor Additions and QOL Updates[/b][/h3][p]Fighting Chance adds or changes some things for the sake of QOL (quality of life) improvements), as well as slightly expanding existing features.[/p][list][*][p]New metallic signs have been added to each of the underground areas, which detail the gameplay features that are exclusive to them.[/p][list][*][p]The sign under the Garden inn lets the player know they can not run in underground areas.[/p][/*][*][p]The sign under the West Forest lets the player know they can not use the \[spoiler]Tunnel ability\[/spoiler] while underground.[/p][/*][*][p]The sign under the South Forest lets the player know that increasing max health will make Escape more successful against robots.[/p][/*][*][p]The sign under the East Forest hints at \[spoiler]The Mangle's existence in the South Forest\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]It is now possible to delete/reset all of the player's save data via the ESC menu from the Title Screen (to reset features like the \[spoiler]Gilded Hat\[/spoiler]). [/p][/*][*][p]The \[spoiler]Dead King Freddy\[/spoiler] page in The Bestiary now has a "Battle" button, to allow rematching from any stage of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]The \[spoiler]gold and purple lasers in the Dead King Freddy battle\[/spoiler] now last slightly longer.[/p][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]Whimps the Weeper\[/spoiler] now has 2 additional "conversations" per area.[/p][/*][*][p]The You Win and You Lose jingles are now considered music instead of sound effects, and can be adjusted/muted by the music volume slider[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Various Cosmetic Updates[/b][/h3][p]Some minor cosmetic changes have been made to the game, for the sake of visual clarity or general consistency.[/p][list][*][p]All major NPC character sprites (Blake, Sara, Saffron, Stone, Manora, Holly) have been updated to more closely resemble their Evergreen designs.[/p][list][*][p]The loading screen has also been updated to reflect these changes.[/p][/*][*][p]Assets on the Steam page have also been updated.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]\[spoiler]Secret cameras\[/spoiler] have been added to the castle ruins, where the minibosses are fought in the overworld, \[spoiler]foreshadowing The Machinist\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][*][p]All boxes that say "You Acquired" have been changed to "You Found". They were previously used interchangeably, for no real reason.[/p][/*][*][p]The ATK+ and DEF+ indicators on the player's health bar, as well as equipped Shield items, will now flicker on their final turn.[/p][/*][*][p]When you activate an ATK+ item, your displayed ATK power will change to show the new stat (30 will visibly become 45).[/p][/*][*][p]To avoid confusion, when Popgoes interacts with the well in the South Forest, he now says \[spoiler]"coin" (singular) when he finds the Emerald Coin\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The first example of \[spoiler]Overkill with a robot\[/spoiler] will now display \[spoiler]"Overkill! x1" instead of just "Overkill!"\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][/list][h1]Plus even more that I dare not mention here.[/h1][p][/p][p]Thank you for supporting the POPGOES series and for playing POPGOES Arcade. We really hope you enjoy Fighting Chance. Please delve in, see how much more fun it is, uncover its secrets, and leave a nice review if you like what we've done with the game![/p][p]I will keep you all updated on the inevitable patches for the game. We already have an idea for some things that should be tweaked, but they aren't major. Maybe one tomorrow. But don't hesitate to check out the game right now.[/p][p]- Kane[/p]

notes.title: 2.3.1 is out! Big QOL improvements and bug fixes!
notes.content:
Another update is live for POPGOES Arcade!

Firstly, a lot of players in non-English-speaking countries, namely Russia and Poland, were experiencing game-breaking bugs such as the game literally never saving. We BELIEVE that this is now fixed. If you were suffering from these issues, please let us know if this was fixed in the current version!

[b]General fixes/additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] ESC menu has been reworked entirely as a settings menu, and now has its own save file. 
[*] Speeding up dialogue has been reworked so that holding space immediately speeds up the next text box.
[*] The first sign in The Dead Forest now just says "TIP" in its overworld sprite, to be extra super duper clear about it.
[*] The note on the bed in the Inn now lets the player know that the Bestiary doesn't contribute to completion until The Machinist.
[/list]
[b]The Dead Forest fixes/additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]LATE-GAME SPOILER[/b]: [spoiler]When we increased the speed of battles, the Jump and Dig battle abilities were somehow not affected. Fixed.[/spoiler]
[*] [b]LATE-GAME SPOILER[/b]: [spoiler]The Jukebox is now available at every inn once it's unlocked. BB's dialogue has been adjusted accordingly.[/spoiler]
[*] [b]SECRET ENDING SPOILER[/b]: [spoiler]Fixed the issue where "shadow world" objectives would remain in the items/objective menu even after deactivating the bird bath.[/spoiler]
[*] [b]SECRET ENDING SPOILER[/b]: [spoiler]The clippable wall in the castle is now much more obvious, with a slight twitching/glitch animation.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[b]The Machinist fixes/additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Robo-BB barricades can now be interacted with before defeating the Machinist to give a hint that they can be used later.
[*] Collecting a keycard wouldn't update the objective until you escaped the cave or encountered a battle. It now changes as soon as the miniboss defeat dialogue ends.
[*] [b]LATE-GAME SPOILER[/b]: [spoiler]When revisiting the South Forest after defeating Pristine Bonnie, the ground will sometimes "shake" to hint at The Mangle.[/spoiler]
[*] [b]SECRET ENDING SPOILER[/b]: [spoiler]Torches and water will be static in the North Forest/Castle when revisiting it in the "somewhere you shouldn't be" state.[/spoiler]
[/list]
This is our attempt at cleaning up EVERYTHING in preparation for the mobile and console ports. Hopefully we've caught everything, but let us know if you spot any new bugs. Thanks!

notes.title: 2.3.0 is out! Major update with new features!
notes.content:
The third major update for POPGOES Arcade on Steam is here, and it's probably the biggest one yet! 2.3.0 features plenty of bug fixes, optimisations, and BRAND NEW FEATURES!

[b]Major changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]BB Ability Overhaul[/b] - Super Speed, previously the second reward, is now the first reward given by BB. As a result, Crit Boost is gone, and 10% is now the default crit chance (was 5% until you got Crit Boost). The second reward is brand new: Money Boots, a perk that will give you 5 coins for every 10 seconds you walk in the overworld. Anywhere. Forever. Enjoy!
[*] [b]Faster Battles[/b] - Battles are now faster. As in they are, literally, faster. Quicker animations, fewer delays. We took the feedback that grinding was a little too tedious, and according to tests, this is a huge improvement.
[*] [b]Power Surges[/b] - People seemed to really like Corruption Hotspots, those red clouds that appear in the second half of The Dead Forest to help with grinding. So we added an equivalent for The Machinist. When you beat a Robot miniboss, a Power Surge will appear in the respective cave. It won't move around though. Should help with filling in The Index!
[/list]
[b]Game balance/features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemy encounter rates in Corruption Hotspots (and Power Surges) are now even higher
[*] Every song in the Jukebox is now 40 coins, making the total 640 (was originally 770, comprised of varying values)
[*] Every Gilded item in the shop, in The Machinist, is now 50 coins, making the total 350 at max (was 700 at max).
[*] Robot stun attacks will now paralyse the Escape ability
[*] [b]The Machinist endgame spoiler:[/b] [spoiler]Due to faster battles, The Machinist's laser pillar attack has been buffed[/spoiler]
[/list]
[b]Changes/Optimisations:[/b]
[list]
[*] The game will now remember whether you prefer windowed or fullscreen
[*] Sped up Shield expiration animation
[*] BB will now mention the Corruption Hotspots during his introductory dialogue
[*] Sara's final dialogue will now mention that she will give something to Popgoes if he returns to her later
[*] [b]The Dead Forest secret ending spoiler:[/b] [spoiler]The clippable castle wall is now visibly fixed as soon as Bonnie is saved from the arcade cabinet[/spoiler]
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] There is now an objective for finding the remaining door keys, after you save the East Forest, if you haven't found them yet
[*] Reflected damage from Spiky Shield is no longer decreased by the player's DEF+
[*] Gilded Dead Deer's idle animation has been fixed
[*] Fixed the Secret Boss's death dialogue missing a period
[*] [b]The Machinist endgame spoiler:[/b] [spoiler]Fixed The Machinist's threshold for summoning Prototype Manora not being triggered by Spiky Shield self-damage[/spoiler]
[*] [b]The Machinist endgame spoiler:[/b] [spoiler]Gilded Popgoes is now given at 200% instead of 100%[/spoiler]
[/list]

Thanks everyone for playing. This should be the BEST version of POPGOES Arcade yet. We still have some things we'd like to adjust and add, but please keep playing, giving feedback, sharing with your friends, leaving reviews, etc. Your support has been amazing!

 - Kane

notes.title: Free version / "demo" removed from page
notes.content:
Hi guys,

I'm making this post to let you all know that I've decided to remove the demo of POPGOES Arcade from the Steam page, as I felt it was misleading to newcomers. As most of you already know, it was never actually a custom-made "demo", but was rather just the free version of POPGOES Arcade that we originally released in 2020 on a different website/platform.

There are a few reasons for this, but most of it chalks up to the fact that it's not a very good representation of our paid product anymore. Not only does it lack a lot of the premium features (like paints, The Bestiary, the bedroom, etc) but it is also a downright poorer version of The Dead Forest. This is made even more obvious with the changes we will be integrating into the upcoming 2.3 update. 

Ignoring the obvious addition of an entire sequel campaign, soon the paid version of POPGOES Arcade will have all of these OVER the free version:
[list]
[*] 40 Steam achievements
[*] Significantly faster battles
[*] Better BB upgrades
[*] Corruption hotspots (faster enemy encounters)
[*] Controller support
[*] Various bug fixes and optimisations
[/list]
With all of this in mind, we feel that the free version may actually put some people off from buying the paid version in ways that we have already addressed in updates we have worked on. Make sense?

When we are completely done with the game, we may work on a new free demo that provides a snippet of the premium experience, rather than a large but very outdated version of the game. In the meantime, if you already downloaded the free version on Steam, it should still be in your library. And if you never got the chance, you can find it on the original website we uploaded it, but please bear in mind that it is not a good representation of the paid version here on Steam anymore.

Hope you all understand!

Kane

notes.title: 2.2.0 is out! Major update with new features!
notes.content:
[h3]The second, and potentially last major update for POPGOES Arcade on Steam is here! 2.2.0 features plenty of bug fixes, optimisations, and BRAND NEW FEATURES![/h3]

[h1]Be aware that this update has a major bug where, if you don't have a save file for the game already, it won't make one. This is being fixed in 2.2.1. Please check the troubleshooting post in the Discussions forum for a workaround in the meantime.[/h1]

[b]The Dead Forest and general fixes/additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: [spoiler]Introducing "Corruption Hotspots"! When you defeat BB, corrupt puddles will appear in the three main forests, which you can walk through for a super-high enemy encounter rate. Corruption Hotspots have three positions per forest which they will cycle between over time, so go looking for them! This should make BB's hitlists a little less tedious. Enjoy![/spoiler]
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: You can now force keyboard controls from the "STORY"/intro screen if the game is falsely detecting a controller. Those of you who were stuck on this screen... Be stuck no longer!
[*] The navigation of The Bestiary and The Index has been overhauled. Moving the cursor across the matrix horizontally will no longer snap it to the bottom of the column.
[*] The currently selected colour for Popgoes' vest/eyes is now reflected on the title screen of the game.
[*] The cap for items is x99, but having this amount would sometimes display x100 in the UI for Holly's Shop. Fixed!
[*] [b]MID-GAME SPOILER[/b]: [spoiler]Dead Boar and Gilded Dead Boar had incorrect stats on their Bestiary pages. Fixed![/spoiler]
[*] [b]MID-GAME SPOILER[/b]: [spoiler]The "STATS" section of the E menu has been resized to give all four of BB's upgrades some more breathing room.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[b]The Machinist fixes/additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: [spoiler]Introducing "Gilded Popgoes"! When you reach 200% completion, you will be given the option to swap out your top hat for a gilded one in your room at each inn. Doing this will transform you into Gilded Popgoes. This will turn you bright gold, change your name in battles, and give you a snazzy particle effect! This should work in cutscenes, the title screen, and be compatible with all paints. It even stays when you start a new game! Enjoy![/spoiler]
[*] A special indicator will now appear in the bedroom when you have "seen something you shouldn't have".
[*] [b]THE DEAD FOREST SPOILER[/b]: [spoiler]The clippable wall in The Castle no longer has an out-of-place sprite after moving to The Machinist.[/spoiler]
[*] [b]FINAL BOSS SPOILER[/b]: [spoiler]The Machinist now heals for 100 health for every turn that it takes to defeat Prototype Manora. It was originally 120.[/spoiler]
[*] [b]FINAL BOSS SPOILER[/b]: [spoiler]The damage rate of The Machinist's laser pillar has been doubled, however can now be reduced by DEF+. It will still bypass shields (not a bug).[/spoiler]
[*] [b]200% SPOILER[/b]: [spoiler]If you encountered CAM7 directly after fighting the secret boss, for example through its index page, then CAM7's battle background would be the secret boss's. Fixed![/spoiler]
[/list]

notes.title: 2.1.0 is out! Major update with new features!
notes.content:
[h3]The first major update for POPGOES Arcade on Steam is here! 2.1.0 features plenty of bug fixes, optimisations, and [b]BRAND NEW FEATURES![/b][/h3]

[b]The Machinist fixes/additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]NEW:[/b] [spoiler]You can now break free special BB-Bots from the barricades in each cave once you have defeated The Machinist. BB-Bots will give you 10 coins for every scrap you give them. There are four BB-Bots in total, and they can each convert 25 scrap. That's right, you can get 1000 coins by cashing in your scrap in the post-game! Exhaust all four BB-Bots for one final surprise.[/spoiler]
[*] [b]NEW:[/b] You can now rematch [spoiler]the secret boss[/spoiler] by accessing their Index page after defeating them. If you missed out on a certain achievement, now you can get it!
[*] [b]NEW:[/b] "Antistatic", an achievement for winning a battle while [spoiler]stunned[/spoiler].
[*] [b]NEW:[/b] "Centurion", an achievement for winning 100 battles against enemies in The Machinist.
[*] [b]NEW:[/b] "Hammer It Home", an achievement for [spoiler]exhausting all four BB-Bots.[/spoiler]
[*] The sprites for the signs outside each Inn have been changed to say "HINT 1", "HINT 2", and "HINT 3", because players didn't realise they gave unique information.
[*] The "E" button element in the top left of special Index pages has been fixed for controller users.
[*] A scrap ore was misaligned in the west forest cave by one pixel. Fixed!
[*] The beam of light in the south forest cave is now centred.
[*] [b]FINAL BOSS SPOILER:[/b] [spoiler]Robot Manora is now named Prototype Manora in their battle and Index page.[/spoiler]
[*] [b]FINAL BOSS SPOILER:[/b] [spoiler]The individual pieces for The Machinist's laser pillar now spawn from inside his burrow rather than behind it.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[b]General fixes/additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] The intro "STORY" screen has been updated to say "spinoff" instead of "fangame".
[*] ATK+ and DEF+ now both use "5" in their descriptions. One of them used to say "five".
[*] You will now be given the "Beastmaster" achievement even if you were given page(s) for free via the transition to The Machinist.
[*] The "An Apple A Day" achievement can now be granted to players who had already picked all fruit in the free version of the game. Just play the Steam version and it'll be given.
[*] Some people were missing out on the "What Now?" (all achievements) achievement due to being offline when the final one was achieved. This will now check whether you have all achievements upon boot-up of the game.
[*] The "Pop Champ" achievement is now earned exclusively by defeating enemies in The Dead Forest. 
[*] [b]MID-GAME SPOILER:[/b] [spoiler]BB in the south forest has been moved slightly so that he can be stood perfectly in front of. Was a bit annoying beforehand.[/spoiler]
[/list]

Go, play, enjoy! Let us know if you run into any issues (because there probably will be some - we don't have much of an opportunity to test these updates!) and we will work hard to fix it up.

We are planning another major update, hopefully out by Friday but maybe on the weekend. 2.2 will add features that improve the gameplay experience for The Dead Forest, based on the amazingly useful feedback we have received since launch.

Keep playing, sharing, reviewing! I love watching videos, streams, and checking out fanart. It makes this all feel even more worthwhile. 

 - Kane

notes.title: 2.0.1 is out!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Version 2.0.1 of POPGOES Arcade is now available. This is a minor update focusing on some small bugs that have been found since release. Here is a summary.

[b]POPGOES: The Dead Forest late-game minor spoiler:[/b]
1. Highlighting over the [spoiler]Gilded Theme[/spoiler] in the [spoiler]Jukebox[/spoiler] would change its number from 12 to 1. Fixed! 

[b]POPGOES and The Machinist:[/b]
1. The logo for POPGOES and The Machinist now turns gold when you obtain 200% completion.
2. The locked index page for The Machinist was orange, when it should be teal. Fixed!

[b]POPGOES and The Machinist minor spoilers:[/b]
1. [spoiler]Shield[/spoiler] sprites for plenty of enemies were incorrect and have now been updated.
2. Surviving a [spoiler]stun attack[/spoiler] from a robot would turn all damage numbers cyan from then on. Fixed!

[b]POPGOES and The Machinist major spoilers[/b]:
1. [spoiler]The Mangle now has dialogue for when the player jumps for the first time.[/spoiler]

We are working on a major update that adds some new features to help speed up the post-game grind and add something cool for completionists! Very excited about it. We will hopefully have this ready in the next few days. It'll be 2.1.0!

Thank you everyone for playing and giving us feedback. Keep playing, sharing, reviewing!

 - Kane

notes.content:
POPGOES Arcade is now available to buy on Steam!

Play the game, share your experiences, ask for and give tips! But don't spoil people...

Enjoy the gaaaaaaaaame!
